notes.title: Patch Notes for Final version (I hope)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there, Awakened![/h2]

You blink, and suddenly—boom!—a new update is here. We fixed some things, broke a few others (but then fixed those too), and added new ways for you to question reality. Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Subtitle Support[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added AI-generated subtitles for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now even more people can misunderstand what’s going on!
[/list]

[h2]What we broke and then fixed:[/h2]
[list]
[*] TeleQ thought it was a cube but then decided to become a cuboid. We convinced it to behave.
[*] Mouse sensitivity was just a decorative option. Now it actually does something.
[*] Rebinding the "E" key for dialogues? Didn’t work. Now it does. You’re welcome.
[*] Font sizes were feeling artistic and decided to be different everywhere. We put an end to that.
[*] Melanius in Level 3 chose to stay forever. Now he knows when to leave.
[*] Some levels stayed in Czech when switching to English. We reminded them about globalization.
[*] Font settings were messed up. Now they are... less messed up.
[*] Level numbering was all over the place. We brought order to chaos.
[*] In the Czech version, the level select screen still said "Level1, Level2..." instead of proper translations. Fixed!
[*] The QR code was pointing to an outdated, incorrect video. Oops! Now it leads where it should.
[*] Doors in the Bonus Factory map were sliding into the wall. That's not how doors work. Fixed.
[*] Level 6 was missing cables for the doors. Now they exist. Magic!
[*] Melanius wasn’t talking to players if they loaded the game from the level selection. We made him more talkative.
[*] Melanius had no translation. Now he speaks in multiple languages (probably still judging you).
[*] If the player received a message from Melanius right before dying and a scheduled message played, the game froze. Now it doesn't.
[*] In Level 17, you could swap TeleQ through closed doors in the upper section—or just walk through them. That’s cheating. Fixed!
[*] In Level 18 and Level 17, Momo just stood there. Menacingly. Now he actually moves.
[*] Dialogue bug: If the player walked away from an NPC mid-conversation and immediately returned, only the voice played. Now you can actually read what they’re saying.
[/list]

[h2]What we added because we care about you:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New posters on the walls telling you what to do. Because who reads tutorials?
[*] A new QR code leading to a video about Melanius. Don’t say we didn’t warn you.
[*] Better graphics for Level 1 - Level 3. Now you can admire the view… or at least say, "Yeah, that looks better."
[*] AI-powered translations for German, Spanish, and Polish. Now more people can enjoy the madness!
[*] Steam Achievements! Because who doesn’t love meaningless virtual trophies?
[*] A brand-new outro. Yes, we finally gave the demo a proper ending.
[*] Momo was missing in all new maps. We found him. He’s back.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.5.3
notes.content:
Feature:
Nothing, just fixing.

------------------------------------------------------
Bugs:
    •  	Lights render poorly for nvidia 10XX (apparently lumen settings) => again
    •   Unify Font everywhere
    •   UI
    	•   Fixed inconsistencies in UI (skip sign was appearing in different places)
    	•   Music doesnt react on settings + new music
    	•   Minor corrections to make the text make more sense
    •   Credits
    	•   At the end you can skip using any key 
    •   Settings
    	•  User key settings are now also written into the tutorial and other dialogs
    	•  Added information on how the resolution setting works
    	•  Added missing binding for Reset level
    •   Level Selection
    	•  The right column contains an explanation of what level selection is for
    • Czech language is now every where
    • Death count has now better grammer
    • Continue and level selection button now works just if you have some save
    • Load level showed the time 0:00 for all yours. Changed to Level name
    •  New Game

    	• Delete periods at the end of sentences (2x in Easy, 3x in Normal)
    	• Missing quote author in tutorial
    	• Some of the subtitles go from the edge of the screen to the other edge and it sucks to read
    	• First sentence please add "and": At the beginning there was a code.

Maps Bugs:
 - Tutorial Maps0:
    •   Added information text that player cannot answer teleqb
    •   Rolling platform no longer kills players
    •   Checkpoint 2 didnt work
    • 	The platforms have been raised so you can't double jump onto them

 - Tutorial Maps1:

  - CreatorMap:

    	• Push the orange box forward to make it more visible

    	• Lower the middle light so it's clear to jump onto it.
    	• After the reset, things will stay down and it will bug the whole room.

- BossFight:

notes.title: 0.5.2- RC
notes.content:
Feature:
- New textures
    •   Open the door to the level automatically
    •   Missing sound for door
    •   Add death counter
    •   
    •   

------------------------------------------------------
Bugs:
    •  	Lights render poorly for nvidia 10XX (apparently lumen settings)
    •  	The electric floor doesn't have a telegraph.
    •   Orange box must be more in front of you than above you. (Making some weird bugs)
    •   If a player doesn't have a save and gets into the map, his position will never reset
    •   Unify Font everywhere
    •   UI
    	•   Changing the Czech language changes the menu on the right
    	•   Exit to windows in the right menu doesnt work
    	•   Level Selection, when the cursor reaches the selected area, displays the message "Must be modified in W_Options "Background""
    •   Credits
    	•   The name of the game is given as Themis instead of THEMIS
    	•   If you switch it to English, the packages are also translated and shouldn't be
    •   Settings
    	•   Switching the window from Fullscreen to Windows does not change the settings even after saving or reloading
    	•   Missing info how Screen mode works (So user may have been confused)
    	•   Turning off Subtitles doesn't work and shouldn't even be an option to turn off/on
    	•   Difficulty change should not be included in Settings
    	•   Sound volume (Music) does not affect settings
    •   Level Selection
    	•   If there is no save, it is still possible to click on Level Selection
    	•   Text should be added to Level Selection to warn the player that the map is for replay only and does not move you further in the story
    	•   CreatorMap0 won't show up but after you enter the map it puts you on a check point


Maps Bugs:
 - Tutorial Maps0:
    •   Lasers do no damage
    •   Lasers switch and kill totally random
    •   Nowhere does it say that teleQBs can't be carried like orange boxes.
    •   The moving platform incomprehensibly kills testers.
    •   After getting the TeleQB, when the player comes back in room, TeleQB turns off again
    •   If the player resets at checkpoint two:
    	•   It's still possible to re-display the pop-ups
    	•   Melanius will not respawn
    •   Place an E over Melanie that you can talk to.
    •   After loading at checkpoint 2 from continue, you can't use TeleQB
    •   When the player loaded to checkpoint 1 via continue, the intro would play again

 - Tutorial Maps1:
    •   The sign returns the message Teleport OFF which is confusing, it should be TELEQB OFF
    •   The little elf is teleporting in front of the player.
    •   When you change the button, you get a different poster... that the TeleQB is on.
    •   There's no cable from the button with the orange box to the blue walls.

  - Tutorial Maps2:

    •   Edit jump section too hard 
    •   Change the puzzle that the player must use the orange box to jump
    •	Put lasers down

    •   In front of the ride is arch and players are getting stuck on it.
    •   Can't finish on 10XX. Interpolation moves the moving tracks backwards extremely fast

  - TrainMap2:

    •   Missing cable from side button

  - TrainMap3:

    •   The player can create a TeleQB through a mesh in the room where it teleports him
    •

    	•   Plug the hole at the bottom of the orange box

    •   Apparently the map is not being saved to your 
    •   Checkpoint 2 rotates the model and you have to give F + Q to rotate the model

    •   A tornado has more range than a telegraph on the ground
